text:
jamie: FYI runtime 3.3 rolled into canary overnight. We're seeing an odd tail in p99 for small-batch text-gen (models: rdx-small, rdx-medium). Not a crash but noticeable latency spikes. Thoughts on pin strategy?
lucy: p99 spikes are intermittent, looks like connection reuse + affinity shuffle. Only started after the affinity heuristics change in 3.3.
omar: SDK telemetry shows a handful of clients are still requesting runtime=3.2 explicitly. If we force a global unpin we could reintroduce older behavior. Maybe we should update the pinlist instead of unpinning cluster-wide.
leah: Agree with scoped pinlist edits. Can we pin the small-batch model group to 3.2 while leaving the rest on 3.3? That buys us time while infra digs into allocator churn.
jamie: Proposal: update model-pinlist to pin rdx-small/rdx-medium to 3.2 for the next 4 hours, start a targeted debug session on affected hosts, and ship an SDK shim within 3 days to gracefully negotiate runtimes. Rollback if p99 > 150ms sustained for 10m.
deploybot: Pinlist update preview:
```
deploybot preview-pinlist --add="model_group: rd x-small, runtime:3.2, expires:4h"
deploybot preview-pinlist --add="model_group: rdx-medium, runtime:3.2, expires:4h"
preview: success
affected_hosts_estimate: 8
impact: routes with small-batch requests will hit pinned hosts
```
lucy: Anyone worried about KV cache fragmentation from model-level pins? Might increase cold misses for those hosts.
leah: We'll mitigate by pre-warming caches on the target pool. I'll trigger a controlled fan-out warm-up job.
omar: I'll open a one-line SDK advisory to avoid clients hardcoding runtime headers. Putting a deprecation note in the SDK changelog.
qa-bot: Canary sanity checks: p50 OK, p95 minor +8ms, p99 up to +40ms on affected routes (noise window).
infra-bot: Notified infra on possible allocator churn. Suggested check: host-level NIC counters and process-level allocator logs.
jamie: Decision: apply two-step plan now: 1) pin rdx-small & rdx-medium to runtime 3.2 for 4h via pinlist (non-invasive), 2) kick cache warm-up, 3) schedule an infra debug window. If metrics don't improve after 20m, escalate to rollback of runtime 3.3 canary. Owners: Leah (warm-up), Omar (SDK note + pin PR), Lucy (telemetry & dashboard), Jamie (exec).
leah: Warm-up job started. Command: `kubectl -n redwood run cache-warm --image=redwood/tools:warm --env=MODEL_GROUP=rdx-small --replicas=6`
omar: Draft SDK changelog entry: "Avoid pinning explicit runtime headers; SDK will negotiate by default. Backcompat: 3.2 & 3.3 supported. Hotfix shim scheduled." Posting PR to docs.
lucy: Dashboard update live: added p99 alert for small-batch routes with threshold 120ms. I also added a temporary annotation explaining the pin.
deploybot: Applying pinlist change:
```
deploybot apply-pinlist --file=pinlist/2026-03-21-rdx-small-medium-4h.yaml
status: applied
change_id: pin-7901234567-01
```
jamie: Logging these actions in release-notes draft: "Canary: runtime 3.3 affinity heuristic causing p99 tail on small-batch text-gen; temporary model pin to 3.2 for rdx-small & rdx-medium; cache warm-up and infra investigation ongoing."
leah: Infra found one host with a noisy NIC queue. Isolating it from pool now. Opening infra ticket INF-4902.
qa-bot: Post-pin checks 10m: p99 reduced to +12ms over baseline; no errors.
jamie: OK good sign. Keep the pin for the 4h window, but we'll follow up with a thorough postmortem and a runtime-affinity rollback if allocator metrics don't stabilize. Omar, please follow up with SDK owners and include the hotfix ETA in the advisory.
omar: Will do. PR to SDK + docs in flight.
lucy: Noting for release notes: add rollback triggers (p99 > 150ms for 10m OR error-rate > 0.2%). Also add note about pin expiry.
jamie: Thanks. Reconvene in 30m for status. If anyone wants to lift the pin early, ping me and include metrics.
leah: Pin expiry set to auto-unpin after 4h; manual override allowed.
jamie: Closing thread for now — action items in tracker and release notes updated.
